English: Stick Fence Pen
A rudimentary cattle holding area made from gathered sticks, quick to construct by newly arrived herders.
Wooden Kraal
A simple but sturdier cattle kraal built with wooden posts and woven branches, protecting herds from wild animals.
Wattle Enclosure
An improved pen using wattlework and stakes, allowing for more cattle and better protection from predators and thieves.
Cattle Shelter
A roofed shelter within the kraal, providing shade and protection for valuable breeding cattle.
Expanded Kraal
A much larger kraal with reinforced wooden fencing and multiple shelters, built to house significant herds and support a growing community.
Guarded Yard
A kraal with watchposts, guards, and reinforced entrances to deter raiders and wild beasts, greatly increasing herd safety and clan cohesion.
Village Kraal
A central kraal serving an entire village, with communal guards and large stores for fodder and water, sustaining both livestock and people during hard times.
Elders Pen
A special kraal maintained under the guidance of the clan elders, housing the most prized cattle and serving as a symbol of tradition and unity.
Chiefs Kraal
A grand kraal belonging to the clan chief, heavily guarded and lavishly equipped, reinforcing authority and offering sanctuary to the chiefs people and herds.
East African Grand Kraal
The legendary Grand Kraal, a sprawling and fortified complex that anchors the clans identity, prosperity, and unity, hosting festivals and gatherings for all.
